summary: Mobile-first Expo prototype tested via web preview at 375x667. Splash→Role-select→Individual→Home→Donate Quick (with risky inputs)→Safety result→Done; >=50 meals auto-routes to Bulk; Deliveries tab lists tasks and advance button works; Impact shows 5 stat cards; Profile loads, Switch Role works; NGO and Requester role flows reachable and render correctly. Language toggle changes label. No red-screen errors observed.

issues: With prep=6h + storage=hot the computeSafety output rendered as 'Caution' (not 'Risky'). Verify computeSafety thresholds in mockData.ts match PRD (e.g., 6h hot should classify as risky to trigger NGO review).

react_native_issues.issue: Two elements with data-testid="home-screen" detected during navigation back from safety-result (likely stale tab + new home mounted). Consider unique testIDs per screen mount or use replace consistently to avoid duplicate tab DOM nodes on web.

action_items: Verify computeSafety() in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.ts: 6h hot food should return level='risky' so that 'Notify NGO' CTA shows.
Investigate duplicate home-screen testID nodes during back-navigation from safety-result on web (Expo Router tab DOM remains mounted).
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext value memo deps include functions but not setLang/etc — fine since they're stable from useState; OK.
donate-quick.tsx pickImage swallows all errors and silently sets a placeholder — acceptable for prototype but log error in dev.
Safety threshold logic should be unit-validated; current behaviour may not match risky scenario from PRD.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core navigation and chips/inputs work. Re-verify computeSafety thresholds against PRD before next iteration.
rca_of_issue: safety-text-has-risky:False — input 6h+hot+10 meals produced 'Caution' header, not 'Risky'. Likely the mockData thresholds map (hours,storage) differently than spec (e.g., risky boundary at >=8h hot). Inspect computeSafety() and adjust if PRD requires risky.
